scope: Complementary read-only review of WidgetsObjectsStorage, ObjectTypeProvider, PropertyDetailsStorage, SubscriptionStorage and MultispaceOneActiveSubscriptionHelper only; author owns ActiveSpaceManager/AccountManager/Invocation/SourceBinding.

findings.proof: prepare launches an unstructured Task holding channel/personal docs and overlapping opens. clear synchronously cancels and discards task/references; it does not await task completion or native close. waitForReady captures only the current task before await and waits both opens, but both errors are swallowed and no post-await space/attempt check exists.
findings.limit: Task completion alone is not successful native readiness or child/native teardown. BaseDocument.open/close implementation was outside this read.

sequence: start waits handler registration then native subscribe before assigning self.data
overlapping stop sees nil data and returns
late start assigns data, seeds caches and publishes callback/state
findings.limit: An upper caller can serialize its own lifecycle to avoid this path, but SubscriptionStorage itself is not an awaited acquisition/drain primitive. stop does not retire callback/handler or fence late publications; deinit cleanup is an unjoined Task.

sequence: stop clears data or another selection installs B
original searchA returns and unconditionally writes data[A]
the public wrapper rebuilds its search cache after helper return
findings.limit: A manager-only final token check does not prevent the helper's prior cache publication or independent prewarm calls.

findings.proof: The subscription callback captures spaceId, and updateStorage writes data[spaceId] and invokes update without checking activeSpaceId, account identity or attempt. A late A callback may publish during B or overwrite a later A generation.
findings.limit: Fresh/current cache authority cannot be inferred from selected manager identity alone.

findings.proof: Both native stop and start use try?. Stop clears active fields and caches after the await even if unsubscribe failed; updateSubscription installs the next storage after a swallowed previous-stop error. Concurrent helper entry can resume an old stop and clear newer state.
findings.limit: The no-throw wrapper return cannot certify successful subscription acquisition or unsubscribe/drain. Manager serialization limits its direct callers only.

safeClaim: A bounded selected-Space prerequisite may attest exact current manager/account/attempt identity if its own transitions are correctly fenced; it must not imply provider/widgets/native readiness or drain from these APIs without additional source-backed closure.
